technical_source_audit.scope: MANUSCRIPT.md lines 686-824, especially Theorem 7.2 and the repaired logarithmic-mesh step

checks.detail: Reversing the coefficient ratio (7.4), setting j=M-k, and using the three residue classes delta gives denominator 27(j+1)(j+beta_1)(j+beta_2). The parity identity (epsilon+2t-1)(epsilon+2t)=4t(t-sigma) matches the hypergeometric coefficient ratio. Both sides have constant term 1.

Theorem A of arXiv:2404.11479v2 gives exact parameter concatenation for degree M. The manuscript's weaker 'up to a non-zero scalar' statement is safe. beta_1,beta_2 are positive, a=-M+sigma is a half-integer, and H is positive, so denominators and leading coefficients do not vanish.

For p_n, Pfaff followed by DLMF 18.5.7 gives Jacobi parameters (beta_1-1,-sigma), hence roots map from (0,1) to (-infinity,0). For q_n, DLMF 18.5.7 gives (beta_2-1,H-M-beta_2), hence roots lie in (0,1). The first three lower bounds are -2/3,-1/2,-1/3. Also H-M-beta_2=N-2M+1-beta_2 >= n+A/3+epsilon+1-5/3 > -1 for n>=2.

Proposition 2.4(v) of arXiv:2404.11479v2 applies to the degree-M negative-rooted p_n and positive-rooted q_n; the strict-half-line extension stated immediately after the proposition puts every root of F_n in (-infinity,0), without claiming simplicity.

For M>=2, p_hat_n(x)=p_n(-x) and q_n are degree-M members of P(R_{>0}). Simplicity of p_hat_n gives lmesh(p_hat_n)>1. Proposition 2.17 of arXiv:2309.10970v3 yields lmesh(p_hat_n box-times q_n)>=lmesh(p_hat_n)>1, which excludes repeated roots.

Remark 2.12 of arXiv:2309.10970v3 states p(x) box-times q(-x)=[p box-times q](-x). With commutativity, p_hat_n box-times q_n=[p_n box-times q_n](-x), so the reflected convolution's simple positive roots correspond to simple negative roots of F_n.
M=0 is a non-zero constant and M=1 is a degree-one polynomial; Proposition 2.17 is not invoked there. Thus every integer n>=2 is covered despite Definition 2.16 requiring degree at least two.

F_n(-4s/27) has simple positive roots. Equation (7.6) transfers these to the reciprocal polynomial; the non-zero constant and leading coefficients of P_n then make reciprocation bijective on non-zero roots, preserving simplicity and positivity.

nonblocking_recommendations: For immutable citation display, use versioned arXiv URLs ending in v2 and v3, not only generic abstract URLs plus a BibTeX version field.
For maximum reader auditability, cite DLMF equations 15.8.1, 18.5.7 and 18.16.1 explicitly in the proof text rather than only the three broad sections.

limitations: This is heuristic WebSearch screening, not Turnitin, iThenticate or another professional full-corpus similarity service.
